description: This file contains functions for form and batch generation and processing within Drupal, including deprecated preprocess functions, select options handling, batch operation management, and queue handling.

methods.name: template_preprocess_select
methods.description: Prepares variables for select element templates; calls deprecated preprocess and preprocessSelect service.

methods.name: form_select_options
methods.description: Converts select element options into a structured array, handling nested optgroups and sorting.

methods.name: form_get_options
methods.description: Returns indexes of options matching a given key, without support for optgroups.

methods.name: template_preprocess_fieldset
methods.description: Prepares variables for fieldset templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_details
methods.description: Prepares variables for details element templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_radios
methods.description: Prepares variables for radios templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_checkboxes
methods.description: Prepares variables for checkboxes templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_vertical_tabs
methods.description: Prepares variables for vertical tabs templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_input
methods.description: Prepares variables for input templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_form
methods.description: Prepares variables for form templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_textarea
methods.description: Prepares variables for textarea templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_form_element
methods.description: Prepares variables for form element templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: template_preprocess_form_element_label
methods.description: Prepares variables for form label templates; calls deprecated preprocess.

methods.name: batch_set
methods.description: Creates and adds a batch set for processing, initializing batch properties and handling batch queueing.

methods.name: _batch_append_set
methods.description: Appends a batch set to a running batch, maintaining execution order and queueing operations.

methods.name: batch_process
methods.description: Processes the batch, initiating or continuing batch operations, handling redirection and queue management.

methods.name: _batch_populate_queue
methods.description: Populates a job queue with operations from a batch set, creating queue items.

methods.name: _batch_queue
methods.description: Returns a queue object for a batch set, caching instances for reuse.
